item.title: ‘At least know how to hold a bat’: SC takes swipe at non-cricketers running cricket bodies
item.description: Top court refuses to lift stay on MCA polls, flags “bumper” membership surge and governance farce

item.title: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake hits Myanmar; tremors felt in Kolkata, parts of Bangladesh
item.description: Shallow quake centred east of Akyab; no reports of casualties or damage

item.title: US downs Iranian drone in Arabian Sea as tensions rise ahead of planned nuclear talks
item.description: Relations between Washington and Tehran have flared again after the US said a Navy fighter jet shot down an Iranian drone approaching an American aircraft carrier in the Arabian Sea, casting fresh doubt over long-anticipated nuclear talks.

item.title: Gas tanker overturns in Khandala ghat, paralysing Mumbai–Pune Expressway overnight
item.description: Traffic on the Mumbai–Pune Expressway came to a standstill overnight after a gas tanker overturned in the Khandala Ghat section on Tuesday evening, triggering a prolonged traffic jam that left hundreds of motorists stranded for more than 12 hours.

item.title: Security forces prepare final push against JeM militants holed up in Udhampur cave
item.description: Security forces are set for a final assault on two JeM militants hiding in a cave in Jammu and Kashmir’s Udhampur district after a tense night passed without any firing, officials said.

item.title: Saif al-Islam Gaddafi killed by gunfire, Libyan authorities confirm
item.description: Saif al-Islam Gaddafi, the most prominent son of Libya’s late leader Muammar Gaddafi, has been killed after sustaining gunshot wounds, Libyan officials and sources close to his family said this week.

item.title: US reaches deal to protect identities of Epstein victims after document release errors
item.description: The US justice department has reached a deal with lawyers for Jeffrey Epstein’s victims to protect the identities of nearly 100 women after major redaction failures in a recent court document release, a New York judge was told.

item.title: Trump signs $1.2tn funding bill to end partial US government shutdown
item.description: US President Donald Trump has signed a roughly $1.2 trillion government funding package, bringing an end to the partial federal shutdown that began over the weekend and averting further immediate disruption to government services.

item.title: Congress questions transparency of India–US trade deal, alleges farm concessions
item.description: India’s Congress party has stepped up its attack on the government over the newly announced India–US trade deal, accusing it of hiding key details and conceding ground on agricultural imports while relying on “spin” to shape the narrative.

item.title: Ghaziabad: 3 minor sisters die after jumping from high-rise; cops probe online gaming angle
item.description: Parents had objected to excessive gaming; circumstances leading to deaths under investigation
